title: CLI shape: surfaced (5-task session)
description: Exercises a 5-task session against a fake `moose` CLI whose surface uses the surfaced shape: Deep + 7 top-level verb aliases (git-style: init, dev, build, logs, ps, ls, seed). Measures whether the agent can complete all five related operations and how much exploration each shape demands.
lede: Both top-level shortcuts and full namespaced paths dispatch to the same capabilities. The agent must initialise a project, seed a remote ClickHouse, check running processes, list tables, and search logs, in that order.

tasks.description: Initialise a Moose project named events using the python-ckh template.
Seed the local ClickHouse from a remote ClickHouse URL.
List the Tables in the running project.
Search the Moose logs for the term 'error'.

infrastructure.description: No databases or external services. The simulated `moose` wrapper for the surfaced variant is installed at /usr/local/bin/moose and logs every invocation as JSON to /workspace/moose.log.
